SceneLive_000: [Post-summon meeting] If you clearly agree to follow this person, the system records that you start following. If you clearly say this meeting is over, the system ends it. If this person instead asks you to summon someone from the guide-and-summon NPC list, the system records a summon; if they ask you to lead them to a target on that list, it records guidance. Speak naturally in the main reply; do not write tags yourself.
SceneLive_001: [Currently following the player for a native rescue] If this person explicitly asks you to stop and you agree, the system records that rescue following stops. Speak naturally in the main reply; do not write tags yourself.
SceneLive_002: [Rescue following] If this person explicitly asks you to follow and escape together and you agree, the system records native rescue following. Speak naturally in the main reply; do not write tags yourself.
SceneLive_003: [Post-summon meeting] If the player explicitly asks you to follow, accompany or protect them in the current scene and you clearly agree in your reply, the system records that you start following. If the player explicitly ends the meeting or asks you to return, the system records that following stops and your post is restored. If the player instead asks you to summon someone from the guide-and-summon NPC list, the system records a summon; if they ask you to lead them to a target on that list, it records guidance. Speak naturally in the main reply; do not write tags yourself.
SceneLive_004: [Currently following the player] If the player explicitly asks you to stop following, leave or return to your post and you clearly agree in your reply, the system records that following stops. If the player instead asks you to summon someone from the guide-and-summon NPC list, it records a summon; if they ask you to lead them to a target on that list, it records guidance. Speak naturally in the main reply; do not write tags yourself.
SceneLive_005: [Scene following] If the player explicitly asks you to follow, accompany, protect or travel with them in this scene and you clearly agree unconditionally in your reply, the system records that you start following. If you are already following and the player explicitly asks you to stop, leave or return to your post and you clearly agree, the system records that following stops. This applies only to the current scene, not world-map party orders. Speak naturally in the main reply; do not write tags yourself.
